sense.text:
Never give up, never give in. In the worst difficulty it is not a thought of giving up, because these trials must go on so that we learn from them: learn to be good leaders, good fathers and good brothers.

“Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness.” That is what these leaders and brothers have done for me: they keep me going when I am around them, and they made sure to build me up until I was back to my full state. It is hard. The bullets that come in the war room, at what is called the judgment seat, are medicine, and they are good for you because they come out of love. The judgment seat is not there to break you; it is there to make you the man you are, building you stronger than you think. You need the brotherhood. But don't get stupid thinking you can do it again and again. Let it be stopped right there. That is how you grow.

“Considering thyself”: these are great men, and I see what they went through. And yet brothers give their wink up because they could not suffer, or because of the bills, two hundred thousand dollars of debt. How could you be that stupid, brother? How could you be that dumb, that ignorant? That is all you have. How could you give it up because of a little affliction, a little tribulation, a little trial? You have to stand up.

The leaders understand this scripture, and that is why, when a brother fails, the solution is there: brothers around one another trying to heal each other up, boost the spirit back, wake the brother up and lead him the right way. It is not to get on a brother's head; it is to see where his mind is at. Is the little fall going to destroy you, or are you going to continue?

When a brother fails, you see what kind of brother he really is. The brother who was always alert when he had the wink, now that they took his wink for doing something stupid, is he sitting in the back, or is he the same brother bringing his energy to the camp? The mindset wanted is: I know what I did, I repent of what I did, I want this to continue. Never be the brother who gets knocked down and stays down. We are not in the business of staying down; we are in the business of getting knocked down and continuing on. David, the man after God's own heart, was knocked down, and he did not stay down.

precepts.why:
This message is for the brothers who want to give up, who sit all the way back in the room, and for the one whose sin is wearing him down. God is “the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, saith the Lord God: let not your sins weigh you down.” That is the part every brother and every sister must understand.

When a brother says he is giving up his wink because he has so many bills, that has been heard before, from many brothers who want to know how to balance their life with the truth. The hell with your life: this is your profession, brother. You have to get it together and ask yourself what pattern you are in this morning.

“And let not your iniquities lift up themselves”: so ashamed to stand up for the Lord. “Woe be unto them that are bound with their sins”: that is what God said, not our words. Woe unto the brother or sister bound with their sin. They cannot see their brotherhood or the families made here; they are willing to give it all up just to sit on the couch watching class. A lot of people dying today and tomorrow would wish to sit in a classroom learning that they are the children of Israel, that they have to repent and keep God's commandments. They don't have that chance. You do, while you are still alive. Whatever the tribulation or the temptation, in this house we continue to follow what God said.

“And covered with their iniquities”: a brother so covered that the shame is gone, so covered that he calls an officer to give his wink up because he has bills. We all have bills. Covered “like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through.”

“Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?” “The sower soweth the word.” By the way side, “when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.” That is why, when you are in the street, Satan is always alert: he jumps in these people while you are teaching them and gets them away from you. It shows that what you teach your people is valid: law, statutes and commandments, redemption, change.

On stony ground they “immediately receive it with gladness; And have no root in themselves.” These are the brothers who receive it with gladness, but they never study and never meditate in these words. That is why dumb thoughts pop up in their head telling them to give the wink up. They “endure but for a time”, and no one knows that time but he or she.

“Afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.” The reason he gives it up is affliction. When they are offended, Satan grabs him up immediately. Brothers here in Connecticut play tough all they want, but when family issues come they will pick Satan before they pick Christ, quick. They will be the best rapper, the best teacher, the best on camera, not realizing this is their trial.

What have you suffered for this truth? What have you lost for this truth? Have you ever lost your family in this truth? When trouble comes you flee. A lot of you don't want to give nothing; you just want a kingdom. What have you given for this truth? Stand up. It is a sacrifice each one of us has to make.

sense.text:
Christ himself said something a lot of us read every day and don't understand. “I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them.” Automatic: you have the word of God, you better be ready for Satan. The world is going to hit you, brother; your family is going to hate you. A lot of people talk about stock and how good the world is to them. We try it and see how far we get, because we are not of this world. What is set up in this world is not for us; we just have to survive in it.

“Because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.” You are not of the world, brothers and sisters, so you have to shake that dust.

“I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world.” Did not Christ know that by giving us his word the world was going to hit us? Then why did he not take us out? Because he knew there is a path, and we have to go through it. Christ understood the world would hit us for the gospel, and that is why he says, I pray for them, “that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.”

We are going to face evil. Look at America today, look at the world today: it is evil. Christ prayed that we not be taken out of the world of evil because we have a path, and our job is to stand for what's right. From Adam all the way to now we have been fighting good against evil. That is what the battle is, and that is what the world is all about.
“They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.” We are not of the world, even as Christ is not of the world.

“Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” This is how we cleanse: through the word of God. Every man must take this word seriously, because this is how you are cleansed from the world that is evil, the world that is going to hate you. You have to become a beam of light in that world that hates you for standing for what's right.

So how are you going to give your wink up? Where are you standing, for what's right or for what's evil? Your people are in captivity, and you talk about giving your wink up. Why are you getting weaker every day? That is what the Sabbath and class are for: to build. If you give that up, who is going to build you up? Satan.

“As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.” God the Father sent his Son into the world, and the world was evil when Christ was here. Christ acknowledged how evil the world was, and he said, I pray for them.
“And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth”: the truth, which is the word. That is how we are going to be sanctified.

“Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word.” We are in a time of evil, and Christ prayed for us, because he understood the time we would be in. Likewise we, as leaders, pray for you, and you pray for us, so that we stay focused. It is the same thing.

“That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us.” That is what the whole thing is about: we are sent into a world of evil.

precepts.why:
Christ prayed for us and left us in the world, because the world is evil and there are things we have to fight within it to get back where we came from. We are not of this world, so we must suffer the evil that comes upon us in this world, to overcome it and go back to the paradise we came from. This is not our home and not our rulership; it is an evil rulership upon this earth. That is why, when we stand for what's right, they put us to death.

Why are they killing the media in Gaza? Those who call themselves Jews, so-called Jews, say they are of God, so why kill all the media? Even when they were let into that land, they are still a wicked generation, still the wicked seed. That is what the white man is: the wicked seed. Look what he did to the natives who opened the door to him. America stands upon the natives' blood, and now calls immigrants aliens. He is the alien. He is the killer.

“Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?” Who is going to fight for us against the evildoers? The evildoers are where we are today. Taking a man out of his own country and bringing him to America, the country that pushes democracy, kidnapping him and charging him with an unjust judgment, as America did to Venezuela: is that just, or wicked? If it is hard for you to understand that America is evil, it is because you are evil yourself.

“Or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” Everything here is a work of sin. Watch a movie and they are selling sex everywhere; you are not conscious of what you are watching, and down the line you see why you turned to watching porn. Even a little karate flick has that nasty thing in it, because the world we are living in is pushing sin. We have to overcome that.

sense.text:
“But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.” Lust has nothing to do with love, and love has nothing to do with lust; a lot of us get those two confused. Every man is drawn away of his own lust.

When you are drawn away of your own lust, you are not in control; the lust is in control of you. So be very mindful when you think it is just a little thing. Take every little thing as a big thing, because Satan is well alive here. We all have to examine what we are fighting with.

precepts.why:
This is the lust we fight every day, so you are not confused: “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders.” Adultery is one of the battles we fight every day. Fornication is one of the sins we battle every day, and we must not let it overcome us. The spirit of murder: you see it in this world, and our people fight this demon every day.

“Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness.” Covetousness is a demon we fight every day, because we lust and covet after these things. Deceit is a demon we fight every day.

“All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” So the battle is not really from outside; it is within ourselves. The thing we lust after is within us. The battlefield is the mind; the real battle is going on inside our head. A brother can be quiet here and be fighting major demons; a sister can be quiet and be fighting demons. Quiet doesn't mean humble.

These are the thoughts men and women go through every day, thoughts that travel so fast that sometimes we catch them and sometimes we don't. This is the battle within. Sometimes we focus without, when we should be focused within, because that is where the battlefield is.

sense.text:
Some of our brothers, like those in 2 Esdras 16, are bound with their sin, and the people in the street are bound with their sin. “To open their eyes”: our job is to open the eyes of our people. “And to turn them from darkness to light”: they don't know where they came from; they come from darkness. Our job is to bring them back to the light, to the commandments.

“And from the power of Satan”: Satan has power over these people in the world. “Unto God”: turning them to God, knowing who God is. Christ is a black man. Christ only died for the nation of Israel, Christ is going to return for the nation of Israel only, and then the nation of Israel is going to be the superpower that governs the whole planet earth. If you are not from the twelve tribes, welcome to your shackles and chains. Like it or not, that is what God said.

“That they may receive forgiveness of sins.” These are the people we are fighting for.

precepts.why:
Our people are in a state of darkness, and our job is to fight Satan to get him off of them. “And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins.” Our people are dead, because they destroyed themselves by breaking God's commandments. They are in a state of death, bound by Satan. When you look at your mother, your uncle, your auntie, inside these religions, they are bound by Satan.

So when you tell yourself, I am going to separate from my husband and go to my mother's house, my auntie's house, my friend's house, and they are all of the world, that means you don't believe this truth yet. What is your mom going to teach you? Is she awake out of this dark place? Notice where Satan is guiding you: to the unbeliever. Would it not be wise to go to believers who can guide you, teach you and build you up? Leaving the sister in the truth you lived with to go live with an aunt who is in the world is a good chess move by Satan, and if you are not wise enough you won't catch it. You wonder why the house is not blessed: Satan is inside the home. Satan is always going to be the voice you heard that night and the voice you heard in the morning. You have to be alert and awake enough to acknowledge it.

“Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world”: whatever the world offers us, that is what we followed after. For those who want to go back to the world, look at a man of the world many look up to, Will Smith, who reached the end of fame and money and says it is not what you think it is. If you are in the spirit you see him for what he is: a man in pain, crying for help, his soul damaged, choosing his words carefully. Reaching the end of money, homes, yachts and airplanes, where people think you should be happy, there is no happiness in it. What you face to get to the top is not happiness; it is a feel-good, it is sin. Where life loses all its ability to please you, that brother is gone, and only God can save him. And when you give up this truth, you are going to hit rock bottom.

sense.text:
These lessons are named patterns, because the pattern of the world is death, and the pattern we are trying to be in is the fruit of the spirit. The day the book of the law is not in your life, you hit rock bottom, because that word is supposed to be there all the time; you have to meditate in it all the time. Fasting and praying help you with the battles you go through every day, pleading with the Lord for mercy and compassion and forgiveness. Fasting is afflicting your soul so the Lord may have compassion and love towards you, as Moses, David and Solomon did. These patterns are going to bring us back to life.

“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith”: every brother and every sister should learn how to examine themselves. You have to constantly examine yourself to see if you are in the faith, and the faith is the scriptures. Satan can lead us while we still think we are in the truth: we hardly read, hardly study, hardly watch class, hardly do anything to get our spirit level up, and then wonder why we are in the condition we are in.

“Prove your own selves”: that is the key. Nobody can do that for you but you. Examine yourself first, then prove yourself: what is it I am doing that I need help with? What am I doing that keeps me from growing in the spirit of Christ? Don't wait until you hit rock bottom to make a return.

“Know ye not your own selves”: to know yourself is to be aware of the triggers that can lead you back into sin. If you are covetous, you shouldn't have jobs dealing with money; if you are lustful, you shouldn't be watching certain videos or listening to heavy R&B. Evil communications that lead to porn are music, movies and social media, and all of them are part of this world. If you keep going back to porn, you are not examining yourself properly and you don't know yourself. You have to know your battles, your weak point, so that when it comes you walk away: I like the movie, but I know where that thing is going to lead, so turn it off and meditate in the scriptures. You know what spirit flipping through the media at 12, 1, 2 o'clock is going to put on you. My lust and your lust might be different, but if I know myself I know what my lust is. Examining yourself is saying, Self, we ain't going to do that today; yesterday we fell into watching porn all day, today we are not.

“How that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?” When you don't examine yourself you are reprobate, and you let Satan use your body to do whatever the hell he wants. You have to stop Satan from using your body. The ministry should be blameless; we must not go back to our sin, and we must examine ourselves so we don't shame the ministry, because Satan wants us to shame the ministry.

precepts.why:
“Giving no offence in any thing.” Satan makes us believe it is just a little thing, that this little thing will not lead you to shame the ministry. But the scripture describes Satan as a roaring lion, ready to devour souls.

“That the ministry be not blamed.” That is why we have to be constantly aware of what we do, for the ministry, because people want to prove us wrong. They are ready to pick any little thing and say, see what the leadership is doing, see what the brothers and sisters are doing. There are people inside these congregations Satan set up for this, and when they see any little thing they say, I'm offended, I'm leaving. Leaving for what? What does that have to do with you? Offence is everywhere.

Look at Solomon. Did not Solomon offend? Was all Israel destroyed because of that? No. Israel was still alive and still went on. One man's sin doesn't destroy everything. That is why we pray and fast for our leadership, so they stay on course. This is a dark place, and we have to understand the battle we are in.

sense.text:
“But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty”: that is what we do every day. We look into the perfect law of liberty, which is the commandments, the mercy of God and the grace of God, given to us to build upon. This is the pattern: we build upon the grace. The liberty we have is that Christ died on a cross and gave us the platform, the grace, to build upon, so we can no longer go backwards; we have to go forward.

“And continueth therein”: we continue in the commandments and the laws, because we are no longer enticed by Satan. “He being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work.” You cannot be a forgetful hearer. We have to be doers of the work, because it is easy for us to go left; we have to constantly put ourselves in the works. Sitting in the front, you see brothers trying to hide in the back, and you learn that a lot of brothers be bullshitting. Either you are about it or you are not.

“This man shall be blessed in his deed.” That is what the Lord said: he shall be blessed in his teaching and in his business; whatever he does shall be blessed.

precepts.why:
Another verse that goes with it, saying the same thing: “This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night.” Ask yourself, brothers and sisters, are you meditating in this book they call the Bible? Don't lie to yourself. If you have to ask yourself, you need to do it more, because it is supposed to be a natural thing.

We meditate on it day and night to keep the ministry blameless, because we know the job of Satan: like a roaring lion, he is coming, waiting to get your soul, waiting for you to come off the commandments. That is why the book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth. When you meditate on something day and night, you have no time for foolishness. If you are idle, that is when you fall back into sin; if you are constantly in the scriptures, your mind is focused on keeping the commandments. We have to stay focused; that is the pattern.

Our enemy the devil is at work every day. Unless you turn off the TV and the phone, you might have two or three percent of an upper hand. As long as these devices exist and human beings exist on this earth, our battles are serious; we battle every day.

“That thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous.” That is the same as James 1:25: the doer of the work shall be blessed in his deed.

This is the work of Satan, for those who are sleeping: “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.” Your adversary doesn't sleep. You think Satan sleeps for a minute? He doesn't.

Now when we read the scripture we get more understanding of it. If we know the enemy, we know the job of that enemy, and that he does not sleep. That is why we meditate in the law day and night and keep doing the work.

“Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.” Satan isn't sleeping day and night; he is accusing us before the Lord day and night while we study. So we don't have time to be idle; we have to keep our mind focused. Sleep on the devil if you want.

The devil is at work. The enemy's own men describe it as ideological subversion: a slow brainwashing, fifteen to twenty years to demoralize a nation, changing the perception of reality so no one can come to sensible conclusions. They are trying to change times and laws, to make what is moral become immoral. "Don't judge me": if we went with Satan's "don't judge me", where would everybody be today? Destroyed. The same person who says don't judge me smokes, and that smoke harms himself and others. Your influence is going to influence others. That is why the laws of God are important.

In the mind of the sinner, "don't judge me" means everything, and so does "don't snitch". You see your own brother killed in the street and talk about don't snitch? You better tell the cops who shot your brother. If you see people being put to death and robbed and you say nothing, who do you think is going to get robbed next time? Stupid you.

sense.text:
What that white man just described, the demoralization, is not as easy as he makes it sound. This is what they used to get us into the state of mind we are in. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries.” Why the destruction of this place? For the multitude of its sorceries. Sorcery was used upon these people in America, and then they used it on all the nations.

“And for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” You think you just accepted Christianity? You ask why your uncle won't repent, why your auntie won't. That is witchcraft being used to keep you in the state of mind you are in. All the nations have done it: from the Assyrian captivity to the Babylonian captivity, the Medes and the Persians, the Greek captivity, the Roman captivity, and now we are in America. All the nations have used enchantments and witchcraft against us to keep us in darkness. Satan is dealing with them.

“Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” The Lord is telling the white man: stand up now with your enchantments. Our brothers think everything is normal in this captivity. It is not normal. As Acts 26:18 says, our people are bound by Satan.

Enchantment is a feeling of great pleasure and delight, and also magic, witchcraft, sorcery, wizardry, necromancy, conjuration, hypnotism, mesmerism, voodoo, charms, spells, incantations, mojo. Enchantment puts a spell upon our people. Remember coming out of Egypt, the magicians doing things: that is who you call your scientists today. They call themselves scientists, with different titles under that name, but they are the witches of this earth. Hypnotism, hypnosis: like the movie Get Out. We have been sinking, our people have been sinking, and it is time for us to help them come out. America did not use just words against us; it used every witchcraft and every voodoo it could find to keep us in the state of mind we are in. Look at the Catholic church and our people in that foolishness: it is more than it seems.

“Wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth”: America has been dealing with the devil from its youth up.

“If so be thou shalt be able to profit.” When America went to attack, the Lord raised up a storm and destroyed helicopters and airplanes, because they don't understand the prophecy coming out. These things are already written, and no man can change them. As we win it out, destruction is coming to this place. That is why we are out here teaching and telling our people to repent: we see what's coming. The same way God destroyed the first world with a flood, he is going to destroy this world with fire, and we already see the fire coming. Every nation has nuclear weapons; you think they are going to put them on a shelf like an extra can of paint? A missile from Moscow can reach Washington in twenty-six minutes, and forty-four interceptors cannot stand against more than a thousand nuclear weapons. What Isaiah and Jeremiah spoke of, we see exists in our time. So where are you going to be when you give your wink back? You give it up for the world of sin, and the idols you look up to, like Will Smith, are telling you it is not what you think it is.

“If so be thou mayest prevail.” The Lord is saying: since you have practised these things from your youth, let me see if you are going to prevail against me. Let me see if your little nukes, all your witchcraft, all the forces and media you have throughout the earth, are going to stop what I am bringing in this earth. God has already told how he is going to win in this earth.

Our job as prophets, as leaders: Paul helps us here. “And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.” That is the same thing Christ called the greatest commandment: love your God with all your heart, and love your neighbor as yourself.

So we have to be constantly fighting and understand the battle we are fighting and what we need to do for this salvation. We have to be constantly aware of what is going on inside our mind, because that is where the war begins. As long as you are in this flesh, when you try your best not to offend God, Satan is in full force.

precepts.why:
Paul was set up for two things: to show the elect there is hope, and to show the wicked of our people that they ain't going to get it. “What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law.” The law shows us what sin is. “For I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.”

“But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence.” When you learn this Bible, your sin reveals itself. That is why we cannot deny ourselves; we have to know ourselves. The more you study this Bible, the more your sin shows itself, and you understand that as long as you are in this flesh, lust is going to mess with you and covetousness is going to mess with you.

Lust and covetousness are the two elements we use in this earth. A lust we use every day: a plate of food, when the brother's food looks better than yours and you think you should have picked that. Covetousness: I like what the brother has and would like to have something like it, without envying him. These are common, but you cannot let lust use you, and you cannot let covetousness use you. Then there is pleasure, and feeling, and emotions. These are elements in the flesh, and as long as you are in this flesh you are going to face them. That is why Paul keeps saying we have to examine ourselves and know ourselves.

sense.text:
“For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin. For that which I do I allow not.” What we want to do, we allow not. When the thought of watching porn comes, you know what you should do, so why do you choose not to do it? That is in each one of us. Good and evil are always in our presence; those two thoughts are always going to come.

“For what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.” When do you know you hate it? After you have done it. You know you hate it when you are already caught up in it; some call it post-nut clarity. What we should be doing is keeping the commandments. Why are we not doing it, and why do we call it evil only once we are caught? We are lying to ourselves.

precepts.why:
Paul clears up what he said before: “For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.” Now it is plain.

“Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.” That porn is in you. That lust is in you. That covetousness is in you. Something in you allows you to sit down with the Vaseline or the lotion. It is the lust in you that tells you the cable man looks good when you have a husband, that the Uber Eats guy looks nice, that your coworker looks nice when you are married. That should not be your thoughts, but it is in us, and we are supposed to acknowledge it: Nah, I see you Satan, that's not me, I'm going left.

If it is no more you that does it, who does it? The sin that is in you, reviving itself, showing itself. You thought you got rid of it? You didn't watch for five months, and at seven months it is back. At the job is where everything begins: the flirting spirit begins, then it leads to something else. You are supposed to know better, because these things are already in us. The evil you just did was already in you; it just manifested itself. We cannot let it overcome us.

Satan is ready to destroy anything that moves, day and night, and he doesn't sleep. That is why in marriage the conversation has to be supreme: constantly talk to your wife, talk to your husband. If your husband doesn't spend time with you, what did you do about it? Examine his schedule, have someone who respects your laws, statutes and commandments watch the kids, set up a nice table, play the music he likes, put the candlelight on, and set it up so he cannot deny spending time. You came with a problem; where is the solution? If you cannot fix a little thing like that, Satan is going to come harder.

sense.text:
Satan tells us to stay down, but that is not what God said. Some brothers and sisters want you to stay down too. “The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.” That is what God is looking for.

When you are going through what you are going through, a lot of people don't know it: the prayer, the crying that night, the sadness. You might not show it while you sit in the front, but you show it when you are alone at home and nobody is there, and the tears come out: I could have done better. Where no man sees it, or sitting in the back, what are you trying to hide? You have to fight. No one wants to be knocked down, and no one wants to sit on the side watching the brother do the work, unless you are just comfortable.

I want to be in the fight, the same with the wink or without the wink, so that I am known as a trooper. Each one of you, the sisters and the brothers, don't bail out now. It is time for us to stand up and face what we have to face.

precepts.why:
“Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.” That is what we pray for when Satan knocks us down: that the Lord does not remove the Holy Spirit from us. That is what keeps us standing.

“Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation.” You have to look at the truth with a joyful and glad heart, because you cannot live without it; it is part of your system, part of your life. Where can you go? Nowhere. That is what we pray for when we are knocked down: we don't give up, we don't give up our wink, and we pray that the Lord continues to strengthen us. “And uphold me with thy free spirit.”

“Then will I teach transgressors thy ways.” When we get up after being knocked down, our job is to teach, because we have been through it and we understand what it takes. We have been through the trial and tribulation, so when we head back, we are back to the same business we left off. So do we give that up to go sit on the couch, or to sit in the back? A lot of brothers who sit in the back, their mind is not right; that is straight up how it is. Sitting there in that black shirt you can be in one of two spirits: to hell with it, or bring it on, Satan. Tell Satan to bring it on. There is a God of heaven who will protect us from the lust and sin we face daily; put your trust in God, no matter how many times you get knocked down. There will be a time you have to get stronger to fight back.

Satan cannot take you down. As soon as you get back up, you have to teach our people their transgressions and his ways, so they may repent and not fall into what we fell into. “And sinners shall be converted unto thee.” That is what our teaching is: teaching sinners so they may be converted to God.

sense.text: “To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame.” We have to overcome; that is the title, the pattern we have to jump upon. That is the business we are in. We have to overcome what we studied earlier in Mark 7:21: the evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications and the rest that come from within.

precepts.why:
That is a lot of fighting, but we cannot give up. “Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?” Your mother, your father, your auntie are not going to inherit the kingdom of God if they are living an unrighteous life.

“Be not deceived.” Don't be deceived by Christianity, by religion, by the white man, or by your uncle or your auntie telling you you're in a cult. “Neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind.” A lot of us are fighting the fornication spirit, the covetous spirit, the lustful demons. We have to overcome them.

“Nor thieves, nor covetous.” Some of our people cannot stop stealing even in this truth: borrowing a book that is not theirs and never bringing it back. Confess and bring the book back. “Nor drunkards”: know your limit. If one drink does it, keep it moving; keep drinking and every defilement in your mind is going to come out. That is what they call the drink spirit. “Nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.”

Paul said this in detail because that is the life we came from. Don't be a fool. Satan can deceive you into leaving this life while you think you are still in the faith. “And such were some of you”: that is what we were into. Now that you have come into this truth, don't think Satan is not going to tempt you with these things.

sense.text: “For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.” Some of us think we are something in this truth. That is the way you have to think of yourself: you are nothing, because you can be taken out at any time. It is by the grace of God that you stand. Always acknowledge that.

“But let every man prove his own work”: we have to prove our own work so we don't deceive ourselves. “And then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.”

When you see a brother or sister knocked down in this truth, your job is to fast and pray, not to applaud. A brother applauded when a brother was knocked down, then claimed he was joking. There is no joking in that. Examine your spirit: why would that thought pop up? A thought like that is not the right thought, and now it has manifested in your mouth.

The Bishop said it: we might be the ones in front of you, teaching you the Bible, uplifting you, there for you, trying to stay in the spirit, but we still need the prayer and the fasting. Praying and fasting for your leadership is the key of love and appreciation, because sometimes we go through things like you go through things. What will not be accepted is applauding when a brother goes down. There are a lot of fake brothers and fake sisters too. Be mindful how you deal with the little ones, so that when it is your turn, it is the same.

A brother once remembered that when he was down, the Deacon did not hold it against him but reached out to him around the leadership: sit over here, sit over there. Brothers who do that are applauded. Don't kick a brother when he is knocked down. Don't look at the brother as if he is gone. He is still here, fighting the same battle you are fighting. Your sin might not be revealed as quickly as his. Don't be a fool: be a brother's keeper wherever you are.

It is time to rebuild strength from within; that is the pattern we are going through. “Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.” It shines upon us now: we are learning the laws, the statutes and commandments, we are all gathering together in one unit, doing what we are supposed to be doing. The light is shining on each one of us today.

“Flee the shadow of this world”: the shadow of this world can cause us problems. We have to flee from it, run from it. “Receive the joyfulness of your glory.”

“I testify my Saviour openly.” That is why we are not ashamed of this gospel; we testify our Saviour openly. Christ is a black man. Christ and the children of Israel must unite: he is the Father and we are the sons. Then the children of Israel are going to rule the whole planet earth, and if you are not from the twelve tribes, my friend, welcome to shackles and chains. That is not wrong to say: we had our time in shackles and chains, nobody came for us, and none of these nations helped us.

“O receive the gift that is given you.” Christ is the gift given to each one of us, a gift we don't deserve. And be glad, giving thanks to him who called us to the heavenly kingdom. Did you know you have a heavenly kingdom where you came from? The world did not teach us that. That is the kingdom we were cast down from. Now we are in the earth all bugged out; we can hardly support one another or gather together, and in gathering there is strength and power. Why do you think the white man is dividing us? Are you so stupid you can't see that?

“Arise up and stand”: that is what we must do. Nobody thought we could rise up and stand, because they destroyed us with drugs, alcohol and guns. The enemy created all these snares for us and thought he had destroyed us. Now we wise up, and they are afraid: afraid to see the marching, afraid to see our people changing, afraid to see the nation of Israel rising to the top. We have to stand up.

“Behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of the Lord.” There is a number of us the Lord is ready to seal; that is why we are in here. And with the destruction we just saw, a missile that can be delivered from Russia to here in twenty-six minutes, be mindful what you entertain in your life.

“Which are departed from the shadow of the world.” The world shows us that it is glorious, if we look at it through man's eyesight, but we have escaped the shadow of this world. There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is death. In America it seems right: a job, a little house, a little bank account, and you think this is life. That is not life; that is captivity. But some of us think it is, and that is why we are ready to give our wink up, ready to give the truth up. That is how destroyed we are as a people.

They think giving up their rank will get them out of debt, that the two hundred thousand dollar debt is going to go away. It is not going to disappear. We are still going to be in the struggle whether in the world or out of it, so you might as well be in this truth, fighting with your brothers and sisters who can hold you up, back you up and strengthen you in the spirit when you are weak. Our job is to depart from the shadow of this world; it seems to be okay, but it is not okay in the eyes of God.

“And have received glorious garments of the Lord”: because we escaped the shadow of this world, we receive back the body, our spiritual body.

precepts.why:
This is what you escape from this world, from the shadow of this wicked world. “But godliness with contentment is great gain.” A lot of brothers are not content, so they are in the world breaking every law that exists in this Bible. Get your mind right.

“For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.” You came into this world naked, and you are going to leave it naked. Can you carry the gold or the bank account to the grave? You die with two million dollars in the bank, and your donation was only ten dollars a month. Check that spirit. “And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.” Even that we don't give to ourselves; it is God who feeds us. Seek first the kingdom of God, and what we ask for is given.

“But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts.” There is heavy temptation on those who have money in this world. Money can become a snare, looping you into doing things you would not do; with so much money you are out of control and the lust is so heavy you cannot control it. Some of you ask the Lord to let you win the lottery, and as soon as you have that money you are going to leave. Stop lying to yourself. “Which drown men in destruction and perdition”: money not controlled by God's law, statutes and commandments leads men to destruction and perdition.

“For the love of money is the root of all evil.” That does not mean money is evil. You have to better yourself in this life and make it better for your family, not say "it's going to burn anyway." It is the love of money that makes you start breaking every law of God. “Which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith”: some are not content with what God has given them. A brother had a decent job, picked another job, and now he can hardly come on the Sabbath or hold his responsibility. When they took his wink he complained, but the day you picked that job, you gave your wink up, because you were not doing anything under it. Ask yourself that question this morning. “And pierced themselves through with many sorrows.”

You escape these things of the world, and when you have the new body you are going to rejoice: I skipped this foolish world. I thank God I quit the job that let me break every Sabbath. Thank God I didn't let that job carry me to the grave where there is no return. Babylon almost got me.

“But thou, O man of God, flee these things.” When your whole mind is on money and gain, you leave the job of the Lord undone, and then you wonder why your wink is taken. Sometimes it is better to live off little with a peaceful mind than to live off much and not know what you entertain in this world. Whatever Babylon has to offer, we have to say hell no, because we know it can destroy us. “And follow after righteousness”: what America offers us, religion, politics and economics, is not righteousness; it is unrighteous. So don't fold like a damn card when your trial comes.

“Fight the good fight of faith”: that is the title of this class. Faith is the path we have to follow. “Lay hold on eternal life”: hold on to the commandments, hold on to God's laws. “Whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.” This is our profession. That little petty job is to survive; some have more money than others, but it is still to survive. Don't break God's laws because they offer you more money, because Babylon will destroy your soul. Before many witnesses: Israel already sees you and the work you put in. Don't give it up for the world. Keep on fighting; we are in a fighting business, fighting for our family and our soul. Your job is to revive these dead souls, but you have to revive yours first; you have to love yourself first before you can love your people.

sense.text:
This is the pattern. The pattern is faith; we have to build upon faith and never let the pattern leave us. “Now therefore set thine house in order.” It is very important that we set our house in order, because the house represents many things: your body is a house, the house you are living in. Set your life in order, get your mind in order, with God's laws, statutes and commandments.

“And reprove thy people.” Then you can reprove your people, because you set your own mind in order. Then you can go ahead and teach your people.

This is our job, what we are fighting for: to find the brothers, sisters and families who will fight with us. “And moreover, because the preacher was wise.” Our leadership is wise; that is what God gave us. The Lord set them over us for a reason. “He still taught the people knowledge”: that is what our leadership is teaching us, knowledge: how to overcome, how to guide ourselves and lead ourselves in the way of righteousness.

“Yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.” That is what we do when we go over precept: we set in order the things you don't understand, so you can understand them, the things of old. There are a lot of proverbs we read and don't understand, and the leadership puts the puzzle together.

“The preacher sought to find out acceptable words.” That is what our leadership does: they search things out for us. When the classes come out, they have been searching out what the people need and what the people are going through. Sometimes we teach hard to wake you up, sometimes to break the chain you have been fighting with, so you say: all I needed was that word to stop what I was doing. The acceptable word is loving ourselves as we love one another. You have to fight to keep the unity of the brethren.

“And that which was written was upright, even words of truth.” What was written was upright, and we have to understand it and follow it. That is the pattern. When we go off, God sets up brothers and sisters to guide us back home. You can never say God did not send help. He sent much help; it is you who did not heed it, caught up in stupidity.

precepts.why:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” That is where the hope comes from. When we look at the history of our forefathers, whatever they went through is what we are going to go through, so we are not shocked by what is going on.

That is our hope and comfort: the Captain went through it, I can go through it; the Deacon went through it, I can go through it; the sister went through it, I can go through it. That comfort is why we don't give up.

Don't give up, no matter what. Stand up. Wise up. This is all we have as our profession; don't let Satan take that away from you. Where can you go? Some of us have been in this truth twenty years and up; this is our life, that is all we've got. And Satan would let you leave this truth to make a little video, why I left IUIC? Are you stupid? Are you a fool? You left because you are stupid. You have to tell yourself that.
